description: Festivals in South Korea that run during a date range (default: today to 30 days ahead, KST), optionally filtered by province, keyword and free admission, soonest first. Returns name, dates, status, region, venue, free/paid, a short summary and the kfestivals page. Exhibitions and shows running longer than 60 days are left out unless include_long_running is true.

date_from.description: Start of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD (default today, KST)

date_to.description: End of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days after today, or date_from when only that is given)

include_long_running.description: Include exhibitions/shows running longer than 60 days

lang.description: Answer language for names, venues and descriptions. Source data is Korean; other languages are machine translations.

query.description: Keyword in Korean or the answer language, e.g. '불꽃', 'lantern', 'chrysanthemum', '김장'

region.description: Province or metropolitan city: seoul, busan, incheon, daegu, daejeon, gwangju, ulsan, sejong, gyeonggi, gangwon, chungbuk, chungnam, jeonbuk, jeonnam, gyeongbuk, gyeongnam, jeju

name: search_festivals
title: Search festivals in South Korea
